reserved_note: Reserving seeds reserves SPLITS, not data: every fold draws from the same 220-row pool, so the genuinely untouched evidence is the 2.6x regime and the moved-phase feeder.
denominator: mean per-output standard deviation of the TRAINING rows of each fold (leak-free); the all-row denominator is reported beside it for the LinDistFlow row so the change from the archived tables is quantified
baseline_primary: per-output ridge with an unpenalised intercept on a logspace(-8,3,12) trace-relative grid chosen by train-only CV on multiphase LinDistFlow
margin_reference: minimum over b1a, b2, b3, b4 and b5-primary, per fold
reused_ensembles: archived 220-draw runpp_3ph pools at the 2.0x regime, never re-solved on the measurement path

gp_hyperparameters.convention: one shared triple per arm and fold, chosen by marginal likelihood over all 45 outputs
